name: MiMo-Pro-M23
note: ~2.35 bpw experts, ~280 GiB total so the whole model sits in 7 GPUs (320 GiB) with room for llama.cpp's whole-layer split, compute buffers and the KV of the 10 full-attention layers. gate/up IQ2_XXS (IQ2_XS in MoE layers 1-3 and 67-69); down IQ3_XXS in the outer layers 1-9 and 60-69, IQ2_S in 10-59 (down is the sensitive one; the outer layers the most). Attention qkv/o Q4_K (dense bytes set decode speed, as G-M24 for GLM-5.3). Router/bias F32, embed/output Q6_K, layer 0 dense Q6_K, MTP blocks 70-72 Q4_K. Reference point: AesSedai's target-bpw BPW2.5 (297.6 GiB) has KLD 0.262 vs BF16.
